study type: Human cross-sectional study combined with animal model and in-vitro experiments
outcome: FOS protein levels in placental villi
NGF protein levels in placental villi
Learning and memory (Morris water maze in rats)
Transcriptome analysis (hippocampal and hypothalamic neuronal pathways in rats)
cohort: The human cohort included 20 women with PCOS and 32 healthy women who underwent caesarean deliveries with a single female foetus, and their female offspring; the study also used female F1 and F2 offspring in a rat model of PCOS.
finding: Female infants of women with PCOS exhibited significantly lower total and behaviour subscales of Dubowitz scoring, which was linked to downregulated FOS and NGF protein levels in placental villi and FOS regulation of neurotrophins affecting neurobehavioural development.
mod_finding: All human participants underwent caesarean deliveries, thus mode of birth differences were not investigated in the human cohort.
followup_time: Immediate postnatal for human offspring; up to adulthood for rat offspring
